mentions.description: This tool personalizes website content for each visitor with minimal setup, integrating as a simple script tag. It has just launched and the builder invites people to try it and reach out via the email in their profile.

Kenobi / https://kenobi.ai

I’m working on a way to personalize the content of your website to any visitor - with minimal setup (it’s just a script tag). We’ve just launched so if anyone wants to try it and reach out my email is in my profile!
